server: Temporary Vite config inherits project config, disables HMR/watch only to avoid filesystem-mutating tests reloading captures; no product configuration change.

reproduction.instructions: Copy the three capture scripts and vite.config.mjs into tmp/, preserving their names. From repository root start npx vite --config tmp/vite.config.mjs; run node tmp/capture.mjs for the original desktop fixture, node tmp/capture-mobile.mjs for corrected mobile and guide captures, then node tmp/capture-guide-prose.mjs for guide prose. Only the desktop captures from the original run are accepted. The final mobile script uses the canonical performance-nudge dismissal and asserts both notices hidden. All scripts inherit project app configuration; the temporary Vite config disables HMR/watch only to prevent filesystem-mutating tests reloading evidence.

limitations: Software-rendered browser emulation, not physical-device or hardware LOW profiling.
Ten furnishing outputs directly granted for presentation only; actual trainer/pattern/craft behavior is covered by simulation tests.
No placement or final GLB acceptance.
Furnishings and recipe patterns are both ineligible for equipment and action slots.
Portrait game viewport displays the existing rotate-device curtain; portrait guide remains usable.
Unsent mail preview covers three longest pattern names.
Browser fixture calls actual Options language hook; earlier mislabeled English captures are superseded.

review.scope: Sixteen desktop game captures, twenty-two touch landscape/portrait captures, two guide catalog captures and two guide catalog-prose captures. Every retained capture visually inspected. All thirteen icons appear in bags/bank, three actual Quartermaster purchases and unsent mail pattern parcels are visible, trainer affordable/skill-locked/no-copper sample states are clear, and six Hearth locales render correctly.
review.superseded: Earlier attempts and v6 mobile captures were rejected; their renders are not selected in this final manifest.
